title: BUI Milling Spares Vendor-Side Catalog & KYP Schema (v2)
description: Strict Draft-07 JSON Schema enforcing vendor profile, canonical Indian & Western product aliases, commercial pricing/packaging/logistics envelope columns, and domain-verified JSONB specs across all 11 milling spare categories (103 products).

aliases.description: Common Indian mandi/mill-store and Western OEM aliases for search, WhatsApp bot intent matching, and vendor catalog lookup.

price_per_unit.description: Base price per unit_of_sale in INR (excluding GST/taxes).

discount_percent.description: Offered percentage discount on price_per_unit (0 to 100).

weight_per_unit_kg.description: Net or gross unit weight in kilograms per unit_of_sale.

package_quantity.description: Number of unit_of_sale items contained in one standard shipping package.

package_dimensions.description: Standard package dimensions in centimeters (Length x Width x Height).

delivery_time_days.description: Minimum/standard dispatch lead time in days (0 indicates ex-stock / ready dispatch).

delivery_time_max_days.description: Optional upper bound in days when a vendor quotes a lead-time range (e.g., 1-2 days -> delivery_time_days=1, delivery_time_max_days=2).

vendor_name.description: Registered business or trading name of the vendor.

contact_person.description: Primary sales or account contact person at the vendor.

location.description: City / industrial cluster / state of the vendor.

address.description: Full street, industrial estate, and PIN code address of the vendor.

year_of_establishment.description: Four-digit year the vendor business was established.

vendor_type.description: Supply chain role of the vendor.

date_added.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the vendor SKU record was added.

specs.description: Product-specific technical attributes validated strictly against the definition matching product_key.
